label: Control
description: Reads an expression control (slider, checkbox, dropdown...) defined in Globals.
verify: Changing the control in AE changes the result.

label: Layer
verify: Renaming the layer in AE without updating Globals makes the expression error.

label: This Layer
description: The layer the expression is on.

label: Parent Layer
description: This layer's parent. Errors if the layer has no parent.
verify: With a parent set, Layer Name Number reads the parent's name.

label: Has Parent
description: True when this layer has a parent.
verify: Toggling the parent switches a Select between its two inputs.

label: Property
description: A property of a layer (this layer if none is wired). Outputs the property object and its value.
verify: Value matches the referenced property in AE.

label: Dropdown Text (AE 26)
description: The selected item's text of a Dropdown Menu Control (AE 26 .text), instead of its 1-based index.
verify: With the dropdown on its second item, the text output equals that item's label.
